import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter out derived features as they're often not suitable for causal inference
    non_derived_ids = [fid for fid, t in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) if t != 'derived']
    non_derived_indices = [feats.column(fid) for fid in non_derived_ids]
    
    # Calculate effect sizes (mean difference in outcome groups)
    y = feats.y
    x = feats.x[:, non_derived_indices]
    
    # Compute mean differences for each feature
    means_1 = np.mean(x[y == 1], axis=0)
    means_0 = np.mean(x[y == 0], axis=0)
    effect_sizes = means_1 - means_0
    
    # Rank by absolute effect size
    ranked_indices = np.argsort(np.abs(effect_sizes))[::-1]
    top_features = [non_derived_ids[i] for i in ranked_indices[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Check for near-duplicates (correlation > 0.6) and remove them
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(x.T)
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(non_derived_ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(non_derived_ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i, j]) > 0.6:
                to_remove.add(non_derived_ids[j])
    
    # Remove near-duplicates
    final_drivers = [fid for fid in top_features if fid not in to_remove][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    
    # Build columns list with only top features
    columns = tuple(final_drivers)
    
    # Build products list with highly correlated pairs among top features (limit to 3 pairs max)
    products = []
    top_indices = [non_derived_ids.index(fid) for fid in final_drivers if fid in non_derived_ids]
    for i in range(len(top_indices)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(top_indices)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[top_indices[i], top_indices[j]]) > 0.6 and len(products) < 3:
                fid_i = non_derived_ids[top_indices[i]]
                fid_j = non_derived_ids[top_indices[j]]
                products.append((fid_i, fid_j))
    
    # Build loadings dictionary using effect sizes as weights for top features only
    loadings = dict(zip(final_drivers, effect_sizes[[non_derived_ids.index(fid) for fid in final_drivers]]))
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(final_drivers),
        columns=columns,
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
